canonicalTitleTh: ถอดรหัสพื้นที่วิกฤต (Hotspots) กลุ่มโรค NCDs และภาวะเนือยนิ่งในประเทศไทย: การสังเคราะห์บิ๊กดาต้าสาธารณสุขสู่ยุทธศาสตร์มุ่งเป้า
canonicalTitleEn: Deciphering NCDs Hotspots and Sedentary Behavior in Thailand: A Health Big Data Synthesis for Targeted Strategic Planning
canonicalScope: Secondary-data and health-big-data synthesis focused on NCD burden, sedentary behaviour, geographic hotspots, and targeted structural or strategic responses in Thailand.
canonicalIdentityBasis: The Thai Hotspots title appears in a complete research report record.
The matching English title appears in a research manuscript submitted to an academic conference.
The Thai and English titles describe the same Hotspots, sedentary-behaviour, health-big-data, and targeted-strategy scope.
Earlier broad policy-synthesis titles and integrated-NCD titles are treated as predecessor or alternate report variants rather than the canonical public title.

authorityAssessment.reason: Chronology alone is insufficient to establish authority. A later document uses the canonical title but differs in research-team composition and has not been verified as the formally approved or controlled final version.
authorityAssessment.requiredEvidence: A controlled project register, approval record, submission record, or explicit canonical-version designation that identifies the authoritative final report.

publicationRelationship.note: A conference manuscript uses the canonical English title. This supports title and scope reconciliation but does not by itself establish the authoritative final-report file or a governed project-publication binding.
